title: Object, property and function authorization negative test results
description: For every API operation, automated negative tests that call it as another tenant, another user in the same tenant, a lower role and an AI agent principal, asserting denial; plus tests that responses omit properties the caller is not entitled to and that writes ignore or reject unauthorized properties.
format: Test results plus operation-by-principal coverage matrix

title: API credential inventory and lifecycle records
description: Inventory of partner and service API credentials with owner, tenant binding, scopes, creation, last use, expiry and rotation events; credential secrets stored only as hashes or in a managed secret store.

title: Rate limit and business-flow limit configuration and test results
description: Configured per-principal, per-tenant and per-operation request limits and business-flow limits (for example recipients created per day, grant splitting thresholds), with load and abuse test results.

title: Contract conformance and API inventory check
description: Per-build comparison of the deployed API surface against authoritative OpenAPI and event contracts: undocumented operations, schema drift, unversioned changes, deprecated versions still served, with schema validation enforcement confirmed.

title: Webhook signature, replay and delivery records
description: Per-event records of signature verification result, timestamp tolerance, deduplication decision and delivery outcome for inbound and outbound webhooks, plus replay and tampering test results.
format: Event log entries plus test report

title: Idempotency and duplicate-effect test results
description: Tests that replay, retry and concurrently submit mutating requests with the same and different idempotency keys and payloads, asserting a single effect, stable responses and conflict on key reuse with a different payload; plus production reconciliation of effects to keys.

title: API security configuration baseline snapshot
description: Captured TLS configuration, CORS policy, security headers, debug and introspection endpoints status and error format for each deployed API host.
